Bug_Title: BAC: Bad Applet Constructor relies on uninitialized AppletStub (BAC_BAD_APPLET_CONSTRUCTOR)
Bug_Details:
This constructor calls methods in the parent Applet that rely on the AppletStub. Since the AppletStub
isn't initialized until the init() method of this applet is called, these methods will not perform
correctly.
Bug_Explanation: The constructor of the applet calls a method that relies on the AppletStub which is not initialized until init() is called. This leads to incorrect behavior.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug() method. This method calls repaint() which is a method of the Applet class that relies on the AppletStub, which is not initialized until init() is called. This leads to incorrect behavior.
